headline: AXA Mansard Reports 81% Profit Increase for Q3 2026
summary: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc reported an 81% increase in profit after tax to N10.9 billion for the third quarter of 2026, driven by strong underwriting performance across its business segments.
why: AXA Mansard is a major insurer in Nigeria; its performance reflects the broader health of the local insurance and financial services sector.

impacts.why: The company reported significant profit growth.
